name: RES token fee settlement against manipulable pair state
summary: RES's public thisAToB() sells the token contract's accumulated RES into the RES/USDT pair and then burns the full pre-swap amount from the pair and syncs, while fee payouts in ALL are priced off live pair reserves. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, bought RES, called thisAToB to burn the pair's RES and sold back into the shrunken reserve, draining USDT.
notes: Loss is the USDT the RES/USDT and ALL/USDT pairs lost across the attacker's two transactions and three later copycat contracts (0x9b0187…, 0xcfeb33…, 0xe9b6a7…) that repeated the pair burn.

The ALL the token contract paid out to the attacker has no market beyond the drained ALL/USDT pair, so it is valued at what the attacker realised selling it in 0x4b769926…; its unsold ALL and RES are not valued.
